description: This file contains utility functions, class declarations, and macros related to OpenGL rendering within the ANGLE project. It provides interfaces for error checking, feature initialization, and context management specific to the OpenGL renderer.

classes.name: MultiviewImplementationTypeGL
classes.description: Enumeration for multiview implementation types in OpenGL.

classes.name: ContextCreationTry
classes.description: Structure representing a context creation attempt with display type, version, and type.

methods.name: GetVendorID
methods.description: Retrieves the vendor ID from the provided OpenGL functions.

methods.name: GetFunctionsGL
methods.description: Extracts the FunctionsGL helper object from a given GL context.

methods.name: GetStateManagerGL
methods.description: Retrieves the StateManagerGL object from a GL context.

methods.name: GetBlitGL
methods.description: Retrieves the BlitGL helper object from a GL context.

methods.name: GetMultiviewClearer
methods.description: Retrieves the ClearMultiviewGL object from a GL context.

methods.name: GetFeaturesGL
methods.description: Gets the features supported by the GL context.

methods.name: ClearErrors
methods.description: Clears all errors on the given GL context and emits warnings.

methods.name: CheckError
methods.description: Checks for a single GL error after a call.

methods.name: GenerateCaps
methods.description: Generates capabilities and extension info based on the GL functions and features.

methods.name: InitializeFeatures
methods.description: Initializes feature flags based on the GL functions.

methods.name: InitializeFrontendFeatures
methods.description: Initializes frontend-specific features.

methods.name: SupportsCompute
methods.description: Checks if compute shaders are supported.

methods.name: SupportsFenceSync
methods.description: Checks if fence sync objects are supported.

methods.name: SupportsOcclusionQueries
methods.description: Checks if occlusion queries are supported.

methods.name: SupportsNativeRendering
methods.description: Checks if native rendering is supported for a given texture type and format.

methods.name: SupportsTexImage
methods.description: Checks if texImage is supported for a given texture type.

methods.name: UseTexImage2D
methods.description: Determines if 2D texImage should be used for a given texture type.

methods.name: UseTexImage3D
methods.description: Determines if 3D texImage should be used for a given texture type.

methods.name: GetTextureBindingQuery
methods.description: Returns the GLenum query for binding a texture of a specific type.

methods.name: GetBufferBindingQuery
methods.description: Returns the GLenum query for binding a buffer.

methods.name: GetBufferBindingString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a buffer binding.

methods.name: CanMapBufferForRead
methods.description: Checks if a buffer can be mapped for reading.

methods.name: MapBufferRangeWithFallback
methods.description: Maps a buffer range with fallback options.

methods.name: ShouldApplyLastRowPaddingWorkaround
methods.description: Determines if the last row padding workaround should be applied.

methods.name: GenerateContextCreationToTry
methods.description: Generates a list of context creation attempts based on requested type and environment.
